sentences.text: Graciliraptor is a genus of microraptorian dromaeosaurid dinosaur meaning "graceful thief".
Scientists estimate this creature was about 90 centimeters long when alive.
Because of its evolutionary position, it is highly probable that Graciliraptor was covered in feathers.
In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated Graciliraptor to be one meter long and weigh 1.5 kilograms.
The femur of Graciliraptor is thirteen centimeters long, and its total body length was estimated at one meter.
The holotype fossil of Graciliraptor was discovered in Beipiao, Liaoning Province, China.
Graciliraptor was named and described in 2004 by Xu Xing and Wang Xiaoling.
A thin bone sheath connects the back joints of the tail vertebrae, extending over an eighth of the next bone to stiffen the middle tail.
Graciliraptor was later classified within the subfamily Microraptorinae.
Graciliraptor is placed within the Microraptorinae alongside Bambiraptor and Microraptor.
Graciliraptor fossils are found in the lowest portions of the Yixian Formation, specifically the Lujiatun Member.
Graciliraptor lived during the early Cretaceous Period, approximately 136 to 122 million years ago in the Barremian stage in what is now Asia.
The time range for Graciliraptor is from the Barremian to the Aptian, between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago.
